$note: 財帛宮（2026-10-12）：貪狼.財帛。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 財帛宮 p.436–462。倒閉、破產、官非、盜賊、火災、疾病一類斷語不用；金額、「巨富」一類保證不用；天刑、天月、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用。

rules.text: 貪狼會到｛羊陀空劫｝，你不宜投機，穩穩地賺比快錢好。
rules.en: Tan Lang meets ｛Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Di Kong or Di Jie｝: speculation is not for you, and steady earning beats quick money.

rules.text: 貪狼在財帛宮，擅長運用金錢，卻不擅守財，常常以攻為守。
rules.en: With Tan Lang in your Wealth Palace, you are good at putting money to work but not at keeping it, and often treat attack as the best defence.

rules.text: 你出手闊綽大方，心裡卻精於盤算計較。
rules.en: Open-handed on the outside, you keep careful accounts on the inside.
